# Nxtlvl Social

> Creative and automation studio for small businesses: social media design, reels and video editing, posting, and the automation behind it, from $5 a month. No contracts, cancel any month, you own every file.

## What we do

- Content & Design, from $5/month: social posts, carousels, story sets, posters, menus, festival and offer creatives, brand kit set up in week one.
- Video & Editing, from $15/month: reels and shorts cut and captioned, product and talking-head videos, motion graphics, hooks and thumbnails.
- Social + Automation, from $49/month: posting and replies automated, on-site shoot, full scheduled calendar, enquiries routed to WhatsApp, monthly report.

## Who it is for

Cafés and restaurants, salons and spas, gyms and studios, boutiques and retail, clinics and dentists, real estate, coaching centres, auto services, bakeries, photographers, hotels, yoga and wellness.
